trips.route_note: Frequent high-speed trains run from Kunming South Station to Shilin West in under half an hour, with local buses or taxis covering the last few kilometres to the Stone Forest.
trips.tour_query: Stone Forest day trip from Kunming
trips.why: Frequent high-speed trains reach Shilin West in under half an hour, with local buses or taxis for the last few kilometres to the Stone Forest.
know: Go early in the morning to avoid the biggest tour-group crowds
Bring sun protection; the stone karst area has little shade
Wear shoes with good grip for the uneven stone paths
